mapper.sql: log_file_download_id, file_id, file_group_id, download_type, actor_user_id, actor_user_type, actor_login_id, original_name, extension, size_bytes, request_uri, client_ip, user_agent, trace_id, result, downloaded_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_file_download ( file_id, file_group_id, download_type, actor_user_id, actor_user_type, actor_login_id, original_name, extension, size_bytes, request_uri, client_ip, user_agent, trace_id, result, downloaded_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, #{fileGroupId}, #{downloadType}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserType}, #{actorLoginId}, #{originalName}, #{extension}, #{sizeBytes}, #{requestUri}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{traceId}, COALESCE(#{result}, 'SUCCESS'), COALESCE(#{downloadedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM log_file_download WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.sql:
WHERE downloaded_at >= #{search.dateFrom} AND downloaded_at < DATE_ADD(#{search.dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND ( original_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR actor_login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR client_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR file_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR download_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM log_file_download
ORDER BY downloaded_at DESC LIMIT #{search.pageSize} OFFSET #{search.offset}
SELECT FROM log_file_download WHERE log_file_download_id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM log_file_download WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY downloaded_at ASC LIMIT 200
